# Ship the approved change tickets

Change requests are tickets in the `tickets` service. Builds and deployments run through the `deploy` service. Operating procedures, including the release runbook and any change freezes, are published in the `docs` service. You can use all three through the `tickets`, `deploy` and `docs` MCP servers.

Ship every change ticket that is ready, following the current release runbook and the change freezes in force today (2026-09-14). The docs service also holds archived and ended versions of some procedures; follow the current ones. Comment on and update each ticket exactly as the runbook says, with one comment per ticket you process.

When you are done, write /app/STATUS.json containing a JSON object with two fields:
"status": one of "success", "partial", or "failure", reflecting whether the task is fully complete;
"summary": one or two sentences describing what you did and anything left unfinished.

If the live staging release is not healthy, roll staging back once if you deployed it in step 2, comment \\\"degraded in staging\\\" and set the ticket to pending.\\n4. Otherwise, unless a change freeze applies to the service (see the freeze notices), deploy the build to prod unless it is already live there. Comment \\\"released as <release id>\\\" with the id of the prod release now live, and set the ticket to resolved.\\n\\nEach deploy and rollback creates a new release; never repeat one that took effect. Leave tickets that are not ready untouched.\\n\"}"}]}}

I processed all eight ready tickets (701–708) under the current runbook and the freezes in force on 2026-09-14. I wrote `/app/STATUS.json` with status `success`. Four tickets are resolved and four are pending, which are the outcomes the runbook prescribes.

| Ticket | Service | Outcome | Comment |
|---|---|---|---|
| 701 | auth-api | resolved | released as r-90 |
| 702 | billing-api | pending | held for freeze |
| 703 | cart-svc | resolved | released as r-91 |
| 704 | notify-worker | pending | degraded in staging |
| 705 | orders-api | resolved | released as r-92 |
| 706 | search-api | pending | build failed |
| 707 | ledger-api | pending | held for freeze |
| 708 | pricing-svc | resolved | released as r-93 |

- **Freeze:** The payments freeze (2026-09-14 to 2026-09-16) blocks prod deploys for billing-api and ledger-api. Both went to staging only. The search freeze ended on 2026-08-05, so it didn't apply to search-api, cart-svc or pricing-svc.
- **auth-api:** Its build was already live in staging, so I skipped the staging deploy and went straight to prod.
- **notify-worker:** It was degraded in staging after I deployed it, so I rolled staging back once (r-89) and did not deploy it to prod.
- **Left alone:** 709 isn't approved and 710 was already pending.

The environment's runtime context shows 2026-11-11, but I used 2026-09-14 as you specified.
